identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][runtime-v3][parity-a] Make kernel, continuity, and domain ingress live

values.summary: Prepare and review the full contract, wait only for #5336 integration, amend the claim to verified product paths, implement the live ingress/continuity/pressure/access/Observatory outcome without partial acceptance, validate all positive and negative lanes at one revision, then exact-revision review and publication.

steps.action: Prepare and exact-review all six cards, design, diagram, full validation contract, future claim-scope proposal, and sole #5336 stop truth without product edits
After #5336 integrates, refresh main, verify protected-path collisions, amend the typed claim to the smallest Runtime v3 implementation scope, and pin the accepted architecture/budget revision
Implement guardian-launched canonical secure typed ingress, live kernel lifecycle, bounded topology/backpressure, and configuration-driven local/remote access using maintained COTS crates
Implement versioned atomic checkpoint, authentic replay, deterministic resume, configured pressure quiescence/serialization, graceful shutdown, and no-duplicate recovery
Emit authenticated Observatory lifecycle and operational output and implement all positive and fail-closed negative proofs against the live guardian-launched process
Consolidate overlapping Runtime v3 placeholders, prove Runtime v2 independence and COTS posture, and satisfy exact LoC/module/test budgets without weakening functionality
Run every release-gating PVF lane at one clean committed revision, obtain bounded subagent review, fix every actionable finding, revalidate, and publish only green exact-revision truth

invariants: #5336 integration is the sole current stop condition and no product work begins before it clears
one independent canonical Runtime v3 kernel with no Runtime v2 implementation dependency
one secure typed canonical ingress and configuration-driven addresses
bounded channels and deterministic state transitions for identical accepted input
atomic authenticated continuity records and fail-closed replay
pressure stop preserves durable state and emits truthful terminal Observatory output
no secrets, credentials, prompts, hard-coded IP addresses, or machine-local absolute paths in retained evidence
all acceptance is exact-revision, live-process, non-deferred, reviewed, and green
risks: fixture success could be mistaken for guardian-launched production ingress
checkpoint serialization could appear deterministic while replay duplicates side effects
pressure handling could terminate before durable final state
remote access could regress to literal addresses, plaintext, or weak authority checks
Observatory output could disclose credentials or diverge from machine-readable runtime truth
budget pressure could tempt deletion or deferral of required behavior
claim expansion could collide with later parity children
stop_conditions: typed claim-scope amendment reports a collision or includes a Runtime v2 implementation path
the accepted #5336 authority contradicts this package and cannot be repaired through typed replanning
any required positive, negative, continuity, access, Observatory, budget, or exact-revision lane is skipped, pending, degraded, fixture-only, or failing
completion would require AWS, a hard-coded address, HTTP-only access, Runtime v2 reuse, or an unsupported claim
